cases: sampling object backed up while another clone is loaded

fixes.problem: Latent denoise_mask could bypass the execution-wide unsupported-conditioning fallback. No image corruption is claimed from this reproduction.
fixes.resolution: Use full computation for non-None keyword or positional denoise_mask; forward arguments unchanged.

fixes.problem: The development packaging script hardcoded 0.1.0 in archive filenames.
